Faking at scale is a payroll: 754 aliases, each demanding 105 POA and 16 minutes, a standing bill of 79170 POA. Judge it by the anchor: open, checkable, and older than the reward. Judge it by the nectar: real money, real time, gone before any payout. Judge it by the nebula: a file that outlives the farm. One check, one price, one open book: the farm cannot afford the book.
